meta.title: In an English auction a revised bid must improve by at least the tick size
gaps: The setup is a published RFQ rather than an English auction.
Acceptance of a revision equal to or greater than the tick size is not checked.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Quoted price difference must be greater than the tick size”, and never with a server error.
